_comment: Normalized Fenix failures (FSGAP.Fenix). BLOCK 7 normalized the 40 entries consumers used first (they carry 'users'); BLOCK 12.2 (0.12.0-preview.4) normalized the remaining 344, so all 384 entries of fenix-failure-catalog.json have a key and can be commanded. Key policy: first segment = the system domain of the Fenix ATA chapter (air-conditioning, auto-flight, communications, electrical, fire, flight-controls, fuel, hydraulic, ice-rain, indicating, landing-gear, navigation, oxygen, pneumatic, apu, doors, engine, information); then component, instance (number, side, colour, position: captain/fo/standby) and failure type, in that order, when the catalog distinguishes them; the instance is part of the key. The target is typed only where the contract has an exact kind (engine and fire.engine: engine N; APU; fuel pump; hydraulic system by colour; electrical bus; navigation.ir: inertial reference N), otherwise aircraft. Fenix engine 1 = left, engine 2 = right. Keys are a public contract: never renamed or removed (contract snapshot in the tests). Raw Fenix ids appear only in this file and the catalog, never in a public object.
